name: packing-checklist
description: Turn your items into a checkable packing list.

interface.longDescription: Packing checklist for explicitly supplied items, categories and quantities. Check whole lines as packed and see total, packed and remaining unit counts. Same-name same-category duplicates are matched case-insensitively and quantities summed; different categories remain separate. A merged duplicate with mixed packed states resets to unchecked. Download an A4 or Letter vector checklist PDF and UTF-8 CSV with quantities and packed status. Changes stay in the current widget session; refresh exports to include those checks. No item recommendations, travel rules, health advice, weight estimates or synced progress. Up to 40 input lines within a 2,800-byte payload. PDF simplifies accents and replaces unsupported characters; widget and CSV preserve Unicode. Formula-like CSV text receives a protective apostrophe.
defaultPrompt: Packing checklist for Weekend bag: Clothing: socks x3, shirts x2; Tech: charger x1.
Make a packing checklist: Clothing: Socks x2; clothing: socks x3. Merge duplicates.
Print a Letter packing checklist: towel x2 already packed, toothbrush x1 not packed.

positive.prompt: Packing checklist for Weekend bag: Clothing: socks x3, shirts x2; Tech: charger x1.
positive.expected_behavior: "Weekend bag": 3 lines in 2 categories; 6 units, 0 packed, 6 remaining. 0 duplicate lines merged. Progress stays in this widget session. Use Export current progress to regenerate downloads with the current checks. CSV prefixes formula-like text with a protective apostrophe. Widget shows supplied content with review or packing checks; PDF and CSV downloads open.

positive.prompt: Make a packing checklist: Clothing: Socks x2; clothing: socks x3. Merge duplicates.
positive.expected_behavior: "Packing checklist": 1 lines in 1 categories; 5 units, 0 packed, 5 remaining. 1 duplicate lines merged. Duplicate names within the same category were merged case-insensitively and their quantities summed; names in different categories stay separate. Progress stays in this widget session. Use Export current progress to regenerate downloads with the current checks. CSV prefixes formula-like text with a protective apostrophe. Widget shows supplied content with review or packing checks; PDF and CSV downloads open.

positive.prompt: Print a Letter packing checklist: towel x2 already packed, toothbrush x1 not packed.
positive.expected_behavior: "Packing checklist": 2 lines in 1 categories; 3 units, 2 packed, 1 remaining. 0 duplicate lines merged. Progress stays in this widget session. Use Export current progress to regenerate downloads with the current checks. CSV prefixes formula-like text with a protective apostrophe. Widget shows supplied content with review or packing checks; PDF and CSV downloads open.

positive.prompt: Make a packing checklist: Day bag: charger x1; Suitcase: charger x2. Keep categories separate.
positive.expected_behavior: "Packing checklist": 2 lines in 2 categories; 3 units, 0 packed, 3 remaining. 0 duplicate lines merged. Progress stays in this widget session. Use Export current progress to regenerate downloads with the current checks. CSV prefixes formula-like text with a protective apostrophe. Widget shows supplied content with review or packing checks; PDF and CSV downloads open.

positive.prompt: Packing checklist: socks x2 packed and socks x3 not packed. Merge quantities and explain the packed status.
positive.expected_behavior: "Packing checklist": 1 lines in 1 categories; 5 units, 0 packed, 5 remaining. 1 duplicate lines merged. Duplicate names within the same category were merged case-insensitively and their quantities summed; names in different categories stay separate. A merged duplicate had mixed packed states, so the combined line is unchecked. Check it after all its units are packed. Progress stays in this widget session. Use Export current progress to regenerate downloads with the current checks. CSV prefixes formula-like text with a protective apostrophe. Widget shows supplied content with review or packing checks; PDF and CSV downloads open.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with interactive supplied-content review, printable vector PDF, CSV export, and input validation.

pl-PL.subtitle: Lista pakowania do druku
pl-PL.description: Uporządkuj podane przedmioty, kategorie i ilości na interaktywnej liście pakowania. Duplikaty w tej samej kategorii łączą się przez sumowanie ilości. Pobierz PDF lub CSV. Zaznaczenia pozostają w bieżącej sesji; odśwież eksport, aby je uwzględnić. Nie polecamy przedmiotów. PDF upraszcza znaki; CSV zachowuje Unicode.

de-DE.subtitle: Packliste abhaken und drucken
de-DE.description: Ordnen Sie angegebene Gegenstände, Kategorien und Mengen in einer interaktiven Packliste. Gleiche Gegenstände derselben Kategorie werden zusammengezählt. Laden Sie PDF oder CSV herunter. Häkchen bleiben in der aktuellen Sitzung; aktualisieren Sie den Export. Keine Empfehlungen für Gegenstände. PDF vereinfacht Zeichen; CSV erhält Unicode.

es-ES.subtitle: Lista de equipaje imprimible
es-ES.description: Organiza tus artículos, categorías y cantidades en una lista interactiva. Los duplicados de la misma categoría suman cantidades. Descarga PDF o CSV. Las marcas permanecen en la sesión actual; actualiza la exportación para incluirlas. No recomendamos artículos. El PDF simplifica caracteres; el CSV conserva Unicode.

fr-FR.subtitle: Liste de bagages à imprimer
fr-FR.description: Organisez vos articles, catégories et quantités dans une liste interactive. Les doublons de même catégorie additionnent leurs quantités. Téléchargez PDF ou CSV. Les coches restent dans la session en cours ; actualisez les exports pour les inclure. Aucun article n’est recommandé. Le PDF simplifie les caractères ; le CSV conserve Unicode.

ja-JP.subtitle: 荷造りリストの確認と印刷
ja-JP.description: 入力した品名、分類、数量をチェック可能な荷造りリストに整理します。同じ分類の重複は数量を合計します。PDFとCSVを出力できます。チェック状態は現在のセッション内のみで、出力に反映するには更新が必要です。品物の推薦は行いません。PDFは一部の文字を置換し、CSVはUnicodeを保持します。

pt-BR.subtitle: Lista de bagagem para imprimir
pt-BR.description: Organize seus itens, categorias e quantidades em uma lista interativa. Duplicatas na mesma categoria somam quantidades. Baixe PDF ou CSV. As marcações ficam na sessão atual; atualize a exportação para incluí-las. Não recomendamos itens. O PDF simplifica caracteres; o CSV preserva Unicode.
